simple.meaning: פֹּכֶרֶת צְבָיִים (Pôkereth Tsᵉbâyîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “Pokereth-Tsebajim , one of the 'servants of Solomon'.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פֹּכֶרֶת צְבָיִים (H6380) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:57, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֹּכֶרֶת צְבָיִים (H6380) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פֹּכֶרֶת צְבָיִים (H6380) before moving outward to related references.
